newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gas oil stabilises, mogas dips.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil stabilises, mogas dips.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday with gas oil showing signs of a bottom.
Gasoline slipped after U.S. data showed a big rise in supplies, but strong buying steadied prices.
Naphtha fell with end user demand seen fulfilled.
Gas oil cargoes showed signs of bottoming out as the arbitrage from the U.S. to Europe closed and European traders began to export product to India.
Fuel oil was steady after barges recovered after an initial knock down, in what was seen as related to a pricing manoeuvre.
